configurePresets.name: windows-cuda-rtx
configurePresets.description: Direct llama.cpp with CUDA >= 13.4 (13.5 preferred) for RTX 30/40/50-series (sm_86, sm_89, sm_120a), CUDA Graphs, and all quantized Flash Attention kernels.

configurePresets.name: windows-cuda-blackwell
configurePresets.displayName: Windows CUDA Blackwell (NVIDIA RTX 50-series sm_120a, Release)
configurePresets.description: Direct llama.cpp Release build tuned for NVIDIA Blackwell (non-portable sm_120a cubins for native NVFP4/MXFP4 block-scaled MMA, e.g. RTX 5070 Ti / 5080 / 5090; CUDA >= 13.4, 13.5 preferred) with CUDA Graphs and all quantized Flash Attention kernels.

configurePresets.name: windows-cuda-blackwell-120f
configurePresets.displayName: Windows CUDA Blackwell Family (NVIDIA sm_120f, Release)
configurePresets.description: Direct llama.cpp Release build using family-specific sm_120f (portable across sm_12x; requires nvcc >= 12.9, CUDA >= 13.4, and CMake >= 3.31.8 or >= 4.0.2) with CUDA Graphs and all quantized Flash Attention kernels.

configurePresets.name: windows-rocm-xt
configurePresets.displayName: Windows ROCm/HIP (AMD RX XT RDNA 2/3/4 & Ryzen APU)
configurePresets.description: Direct llama.cpp with AMD HIP SDK Clang on Windows targeting RDNA 2/3/4 discrete RX XT GPUs and RDNA 3 Ryzen APUs with HIP Graphs and rocWMMA FlashAttention.
